# Salonix Frontend Instructions

Before working on any file in `salonix-frontend/`, read these files in order:

1. Repository-wide [AGENTS.md](../../../AGENTS.md) for shared guardrails and conventions.
2. Frontend [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md) for frontend workflow and boundaries.
3. Canonical frontend [docs/FRONTEND_RULES.md](../../docs/FRONTEND_RULES.md) for Next.js architecture, dependencies and implementation rules.

Apply repository-wide and frontend rules together. The stricter requirement wins when rules overlap. Keep changes scoped to `salonix-frontend/` unless the user explicitly approves another location.
